propositions: rebar's reconciler hardcodes Jira project-specific status, type, link, and priority mappings in three duplicate locations, requiring core edits to support projects with workflow variance

a provider-neutral, config-driven mapping seam layered from built-in defaults → config default block → per-project overlay must replace hardcoded maps and preserve existing byte-for-identical behavior when no overrides are declared
rebar types with no target analogue must be addressable via collapse (with rebar-type: label round-trip safety), skip (type-granular exclusion), or drift with recording, never silently forced

non-allowed transitions must be replayed by deriving the hop sequence from the ticket's core STATUS event log, attempting each hop in order exactly once, and degrading to drift on first rejection or when no recorded trail survives
non-representable parent relationships must drift and leave an echo-safe breadcrumb comment naming the nearest represented ancestor's Jira key

required-field create failures must be preventable via a per-project create_defaults config block, and live config validation plus diagnostics must be provided by rebar doctor and rebar bridge suggest-mapping commands
